content:
On 22 March, at the headquarters of OERN, the technical session "Sustainability of the built environment: challenges of the twin transition" will take place, organised by the Colégio de Engenharia Civil – Norte, as part of the "Engenheiros Civis + Digitais" cycle, with the participation of BUILT CoLAB.

This session, starting at 6pm, will address the implementation of the twin transition in a circular economy environment in the construction sector, present the principles and ideas behind the concepts of Circular Economy and Twin Transition, provide a general understanding of current policies in Europe and Portugal in the field of the Circular Economy, and analyse the barriers and opportunities for transitioning to these business models. Participants will also have the opportunity to learn about the recently published PACCO – Action Plan for Circularity in Construction and the 30 measures it proposes for the sector.

During the event there will also be moments for discussing ideas and networking with other stakeholders in the sector, with the aim of achieving a new vision with a significant contribution towards making the construction industry more responsible and sustainable.

PROGRAMME

6:00pm – Welcome

6:10pm – João Poças Martins, BUILT CoLAB/FEUP

6:15pm – Marco Pedroso, BUILT CoLAB

6:35pm – Vanessa Tavares, BUILT CoLAB

7:00pm – Round table – Campos e Matos (UM/OERN), Paula Santos (AO), Luísa Magalhães (SmartWaste) and José Carlos Lino (BuildingSmart Portugal)

8:00pm – End

This session is exclusive to members of the Ordem dos Engenheiros. Full information and the registration link are available here.
